dict.string: QoL Notch sets shuffle and repeat in Music or Spotify when you press those buttons in the island.
QoL Notch adds new screenshots saved on your Desktop to your clipboard history.
QoL Notch adds new screenshots saved in Documents to your clipboard history.
QoL Notch adds new screenshots saved in Downloads to your clipboard history.
QoL Notch shows your camera in the island's Mirror so you can check how you look. Nothing is recorded.
QoL Notch shows your upcoming events in the island.
QoL Notch listens to your voice so the script can follow along as you speak.
QoL Notch recognises the words you say to keep your place in the script.
